business_summary: Anhui Xinhua Media Co., Ltd. engages in the distribution of books, newspapers, periodicals, and electronic publications in China and internationally. The company is involved in the distribution of textbooks for primary and secondary schools; wholesale and retail of audio-visual products; production of TV variety shows, TV specials, TV dramas, and TV cartoons, as well as television variety shows, special programs, TV dramas, and animated series; and book rental, production, and consulting services. It also engages in the warehousing, logistics, distribution, and chain management of computer information system design, integration, and technical services; development and sale of educational software, computer hardware, and software; sale and warehousing of electronic equipment and products, and educational academic instrument and equipment; and sale and warehousing of music, sports, art, and sanitary equipment. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of office furniture, medical furniture, finance art, and sanitary equipment; sale of office furniture, medical furniture, and financial and office supplies; investment, development, management, and consulting services for the communication and cultural industries; advertising; asset management; property management; equipment and real estate leasing; and building installation and decoration. Further, it offers internet information services and financial consulting. The company was formerly known as Anhui Xinhua Distribution Group Limited. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Hefei, China. Anhui Xinhua Media Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Anhui Xinhua Publishing (Group) Holdings Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Anhui Xinhua Media Co., Ltd.는 중국 및 국제적으로 서적, 신문, 정기 간행물 및 전자 출판물 배포에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 초등 및 중등 학교 교과서 배포에 참여하고 있습니다. 시청각 제품의 도매 및 소매; TV 버라이어티 쇼, TV 스페셜, TV 드라마, TV 만화뿐만 아니라 TV 버라이어티 쇼, 특별 프로그램, TV 드라마, 애니메이션 시리즈 제작; 도서 대여, 제작, 컨설팅 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 컴퓨터 정보 시스템 설계, 통합 및 기술 서비스의 창고, 물류, 유통 및 체인 관리에도 참여합니다. 교육용 소프트웨어, 컴퓨터 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어 개발 및 판매; 전자 장비 및 제품, 교육 학술 장비 및 장비의 판매 및 보관; 음악, 스포츠, 예술 및 위생 장비의 판매 및 보관. 또한 회사는 사무용 가구, 의료용 가구, 금융 예술 및 위생 장비 공급에 참여하고 있습니다. 사무용 가구, 의료용 가구, 금융 및 사무용품 판매; 투자, 개발, 관리, 컨설팅 서비스를 제공합니다.
